title: Lab event
description: One event a product engine reports to the Lab at POST /internal/events, delivered in batches of at most 500 as {"events": [<event>, ...]} and acknowledged with 200 {"accepted": [<id>, ...]}. Owned by meilisearch/lab (contracts/lab-events.schema.json); Scrapix, glutony, Lumen and meili-connect vendor a byte copy under contracts/vendor/lab/ and drift-check it in CI. The Lab takes the reporting deployment from the authenticated X-Lab-Instance-Id header, never from the body.

id.description: Idempotency key. UUIDv7 per request; UUIDv5 of a stable name for job-final events (job:{job_id}:usage, job:{job_id}:lifecycle: a job has one lifecycle event, completed, failed or cancelled) and for state changes (see each type).

type.description: usage.recorded: billable usage. job.*: a crawl or pipeline run ended (scrapix, glutony). source.status_changed: a scheduled Pipelines source started failing or recovered (glutony). sync.state_changed: a Connect sync changed state (connect). sync.health_changed: a Connect sync's lag or the WAL its slot keeps on the source crossed a threshold, or came back under it (connect). budget.*, key.expiring, provider_key.status_changed: Gateway alerts (lumen). The Lab rejects a type it does not know without retrying it, so an engine may send a new type only once the Lab that accepts it is deployed.

account_id.description: The Lab account the usage belongs to.

api_key_id.description: The Lab API key id when known.

units.description: Raw units by name. The Lab prices the names in saas/config/pricing.yml; unknown names are kept and ignored. Lumen sends requests, tokens_in, tokens_out, tokens_estimated, bytes_in, bytes_out, byok_tokens_in, byok_tokens_out. Connect sends exactly connectUnits.

connectUnits.description: One Connect sync's usage over a flush interval (job_id is the sync id). documents_streamed: document writes and deletes applied from the change stream; documents_snapshot: documents written by a first sync or a resync the user asked for; documents_resync: documents rewritten by a resync the system started (free, reported); bytes: uncompressed payload bytes sent to Meilisearch; sync_seconds: seconds the sync spent snapshotting or streaming (free at launch, reported). Only documents Meilisearch accepted count.

operation.description: Product-specific operation name. scrapix: scrape|map|search|parse|ocr|extract|crawl. glutony: ingest. lumen: chat|embed|rerank|systemone|gateway. connect: sync.

provider_cost_micro_usd.description: Money the engine paid upstream for this usage (LLM tokens, OCR API), in micro-USD. The Lab prices it with its markup.

credits.description: Deprecated: pre-v2 engines priced usage themselves. Honoured only for product scrapix, where it is authoritative: the Lab debits it and does not price the units. Removed next release.

reason.description: Why it failed or stopped, as a stable code the Lab words for the user; the free-text message stays next to it. An open set: the Lab shows the message alone for a code it does not know. Known codes: insufficient_credits (the team has no credits), gateway_budget_exhausted, no_gateway (an AI step had no Gateway to call), destination_auth (Meilisearch rejected the key), destination_unreachable, destination_rejected (Meilisearch refused the documents or the index), source_auth (the source refused the credentials), source_not_found (404/410), source_unreachable, source_config (publication, slot, privilege or schema problem on the source), invalid_config (the crawl, pipeline or sync is invalid), invalid_input (the file or document could not be read), stalled (no progress), no_pages (nothing could be crawled), delete_guard (a mass delete was held back), resync_budget_spent, internal.

jobGroup.description: The run this job belongs to, so the Lab can tell one email about it instead of one per job. source_run: a scheduled Pipelines source run (id: the run id, name: the source's name). archive: the files of one uploaded archive (id: the archive's job id). batch: one batch ingest request (id: the batch id).

index_uid.description: The Meilisearch index written to. glutony before v3 sent the pipeline uid here; it now sends that as pipeline.

pages_failed.description: scrapix: pages that could not be fetched or processed.

step.description: glutony: the id of the step that failed.

jobCancelledData.description: A job someone cancelled. It is the job's lifecycle event (same id as job.completed or job.failed would have).

sourceStatusData.description: A scheduled Pipelines source changed status: failing after a run failed while it was ok, ok after a run succeeded while it was failing. Sent on the change only, not every run. Id: UUIDv5 of source:{source_id}:run:{run_id}:status, so a retried run reports once.

syncStateData.description: A Connect sync changed state. Sent on every change of `to`, and when a snapshot ends (from snapshotting to streaming). Id: a UUIDv7 made when the change is recorded and kept across retries.

sync_name.description: The sync's label, for example postgres → products.

resync.description: The snapshot that ended or started was a resync, not the first one.

syncHealthData.description: A Connect sync's health crossed a threshold the engine sets (warning) or came back under it (ok), per cause. lag: the sync is streaming but behind its source by more than the threshold. wal_retained: the sync's replication slot keeps more WAL on the source than the threshold, whatever the sync's state: a stopped sync's slot keeps WAL until the source's disk fills or the slot is invalidated, so it is measured while the sync is paused, held or failed too. Sent on the change only, once it has held for the engine's settle time. Id: a UUIDv7 made when the change is recorded and kept across retries.

threshold.description: The threshold crossed: seconds for lag, bytes for wal_retained.

source_limit_bytes.description: wal_retained: the source's own cap on the WAL a slot may keep (Postgres max_slot_wal_keep_size), when it has one. Past it the source invalidates the slot and the sync must resync.

syncState.description: paused: by the user. source_paused: the source is down or unresolvable and the sync waits for it. held: stopped until the user fixes something (reason says what). failed: stopped for good.

budgetData.description: A Gateway budget a team set on one of its keys (scope key) or groups (scope group) ran out: requests on it are refused. Never the team's own credit lease, which the Lab tracks itself. Id: a UUIDv7 made when it is recorded and kept across retries; sent once per budget period.

budgetThresholdData.description: A Gateway budget passed a share of its maximum (by default 50, 80 and 95 percent), once per budget period. Id: a UUIDv7 made when it is recorded and kept across retries.

keyExpiringData.description: A Gateway key expires soon (days_left 7 and 1) or has expired (days_left 0). Id: UUIDv5 of key:{key_id}:{expires_at}:{days_left}.

providerKeyStatusData.description: A provider key the team brought (BYOK) started being refused by its provider (failing: 401/403, or out of quota) or works again (ok). Sent on the change only. Id: UUIDv7.
